root_cause.text: The `rfkill_block` work item was not cancelled during `wiphy_unregister()`, allowing a use-after-free when the work function accesses freed wiphy data.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE and commit message state: "The problem arises due to the rfkill_block work is not cancelled when wiphy is being unregistered." The patch adds `cancel_work_sync(&rdev->rfkill_block);` in `wiphy_unregister()`. The call trace shows the use-after-free in `cfg80211_shutdown_all_interfaces` called from `cfg80211_rfkill_block_work`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add cancellation of rfkill_block work in wiphy_unregister to prevent race conditions during device unregistration.
intent_record.what: Added a call to cancel_work_sync(&rdev->rfkill_block) before existing work cancellation calls in the wiphy_unregister function.
intent_record.how: Ensures that any pending rfkill block work is synchronized and completed before the wireless device is fully unregistered, preventing potential race conditions or use-after-free errors.
